about: What's New 2026-11-22 re-shoots (tests/e2e/whats-new-pair.spec.ts). before.ref is the last main commit (first-parent) whose signature-landmarks.json lacks the landmark, so the before frame shows the generic building it replaced. target/frame are fractions of the 1440x900 frame. Poses are street level (view cockpit) on the landmark's front, the HUD off, so the building fills the target box: the first run (chase camera, 95 m) drew the Handelsschool at 2 % of the frame and every pair measured too similar. Second run (2026-11-22 night): the spec now snaps the camera behind the rider (camera.resetForRide) so both frames share a heading; kept poses are Handelsschool 199 deg/55 m (first run, before the snap), Jungle from the east (90 deg, 55 m, zoom 1.1), Hans en Grietje 230 deg/53 m at zoom 1.5, Kweekschool from across the Plantage Muidergracht (270 deg, 55 m, zoom 0.9).
